description: Post-lowering AST conformance for the mom6_cgrid PPM continuity rule quartet (grids/mom6_cgrid/rules/mom6_cgrid_flux_x/y.esm, mom6_cgrid_div_x/y.esm) at N_I = N_J = 8, N_K = 2 — the traced stage-2 subdomain. Pins the canonical expanded bytes of the two PPM layer-flux laws (zonal_flux_layer / merid_flux_layer, MOM_continuity_PPM.F90:933-956 / 1809-1893, with the PPM_reconstruction_x/y parabolas F90:2327-2478 / 2503-2629 and the PPM_limit_pos limiter F90:2636-2674 inlined from the stencil laws) and the C-grid face-flux divergences with their explicit wall regions and clamped edge index closures; the numeric correctness is verified against the Fortran by the stage-2 mom6_dynamics pins (EqESM stage2/mom6_dynamics.esm).
